introduction: WOOKTOOL self-winding tape measures are suited to hardware, DIY and private-label programs that need a familiar steel-blade format with controlled logo and packaging presentation. Buyers can compare 3m, 5m and 7.5m/25ft directions against the target market.
For a focused RFQ, share the preferred length, blade unit, quantity, logo artwork, shell color and packaging direction. These details help confirm a suitable existing model and sample plan.

faq.question: What is a self-winding tape measure?
faq.answer: A self-winding tape measure retracts the blade into the case through its internal spring mechanism; buyers should confirm retraction and lock requirements with the model.

faq.question: Can the 7.5m or 25ft model be private labelled?
faq.answer: Yes. Logo, shell color, blade layout, barcode, retail packaging and carton mark requirements can be reviewed.

faq.question: What should be checked before bulk production?
faq.answer: Check blade printing, retraction, lock function, hook rivet, case assembly, logo presentation and finished packaging.

faq.question: Can metric and imperial scales be discussed?
faq.answer: Metric, imperial or dual-scale directions can be confirmed based on the selected model and destination market.
